purpose: Stress-test the unexpectedly large preregistered V6A progression without changing the candidate, cutoff, model, sample rule or adjudication. These diagnostics cannot promote a failed candidate, rescue a gate, select a new feature, or choose a new model.
forbidden: row exclusion based on prediction error
using diagnostics to alter the already-recorded preregistered pass/fail result

causal_clock: reassert every selected ordinary A50 endpoint is strictly before 09:15:00
reassert start endpoint is at or before previous China 15:00
incremental_information: ordinary A50 raw correlation with target gap on the fixed holdout rows
ordinary A50 raw correlation with frozen comparator residual on the same rows
direct sign agreement between ordinary A50 return and target gap
same-row versus one-row lead/lag target correlations as a date-alignment placebo
concentration: fixed-prediction per-row SSE improvement V6A versus comparator
top1/top5/top10 share of positive SSE gain
remaining total SSE improvement after removing the top1/top5/top10 positive contributors without refitting
redundancy: correlation of ordinary A50 with existing US/HKMA/global variables on fixed ordinary holdout rows
report comparator-to-candidate standardized coefficient sign flips as descriptive multicollinearity evidence only

invalidating_findings: any actual target endpoint at or after 09:15:00
any start endpoint after previous China 15:00
date mapping inconsistent with the frozen target/previous-China-day relation
noninvalidating_but_material_caveats: large coefficient redistribution or sign flips
lead/lag correlations that are not clearly smaller than same-row correlation
